newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai copper end mostly down, sentiment weak.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai copper end mostly down, sentiment weak.

text.p: Shanghai copper futures ended mostly down on Friday on weak market sentiment, traders said.
The most actively traded November 1997 contract ended at an intraday low of 20,600 yuan ($2,484) per tonne, losing 150 yuan. It opened at 20,750 yuan and hit a high of 20,800 yuan.
July closed unchanged at 21,450. August fell 100 to 20,450, September 150 to 20,500, October 110 to 20,580 and December 130 to 20,620. The January 1998 contract rose 190 to 20,600 yuan per tonne.
Combined volume fell sharply to 46,060 tonnes from 113,450 tonnes.
